title: Momentum Flip
concept: The dot rolls forward with inertia; each tap instantly reverses its velocity direction while preserving speed, letting you bounce between alternating moving walls that only open on one side.

title: Pulse Split
concept: The dot continuously emits expanding rings; tapping splits the ring into two concentric pulses that can pass through nested obstacles, then recombine for a score boost.

title: Momentum Bounce
concept: The dot rolls forward and accumulates momentum with each tap; releasing a tap triggers a bounce that flips its vertical direction while preserving speed, requiring you to time bounces to navigate alternating ceiling and floor gaps.
